operator_text.quote: appartenant au CNRS, ainsi qu'à l'Université Grenoble-Alpes ... une plateforme nationale française IN2P3 rattachée au Laboratoire de Physique Subatomique et Cosmologie (LPSC) de Grenoble depuis 2019
operator_text.value: CNRS/IN2P3 and Universite Grenoble-Alpes; a national IN2P3 platform attached to the Laboratoire de Physique Subatomique et Cosmologie (LPSC) in Grenoble since 2019

summary.plain: An underground physics laboratory built into the middle of a road tunnel through the French Alps, under 1700 metres of rock. It is the deepest underground laboratory in Europe and hosts sensitive searches for dark matter and rare nuclear decays.
summary.technical: CNRS/IN2P3 underground laboratory located mid-way through the Frejus road tunnel near Modane, Savoie, France, under ~1700 m of rock; founded 1981; since 2019 a national platform attached to LPSC Grenoble.
